text.tspan: Day 1: how a pipeline flows, and how to read permissions
Each | sends the output (stdout) of the left command into the input (stdin) of the right one.
> overwrites a file, >> appends, 2> redirects errors.
ls -l output: -rwxr-x--- 1 suraj dev 2048 Nov 12 deploy.sh
On a directory: r = list files, w = create/delete files, x = enter it (cd)
Common: 644 files, 755 scripts/dirs, 600 private keys, 640 config with secrets
